tip: string                        set a healthcheck command for the container ('none' disables the existing healthcheck)

tip: string                   set an interval for the healthcheck. (a value of disable results in no automatic timer setup) Changing this setting resets timer. (default "30s")

option.name: --health-log-destination
tip: string            set the destination of the HealthCheck log. Directory path, local or events_logger (local use container state file) Warning: Changing this setting may cause the loss of previous logs! (default "local")

option.name: --health-max-log-count
tip: uint                set maximum number of attempts in the HealthCheck log file. ('0' value means an infinite number of attempts in the log file) (default 5)

option.name: --health-max-log-size
tip: uint                 set maximum length in characters of stored HealthCheck log. ('0' value means an infinite log length) (default 500)

option.name: --health-on-failure
tip: string                 action to take once the container turns unhealthy (default "none")

option.name: --health-retries
tip: uint                      the number of retries allowed before a healthcheck is considered to be unhealthy (default 3)

option.name: --health-start-period
tip: string               the initialization time needed for a container to bootstrap (default "0s")

option.name: --health-startup-cmd
tip: string                Set a startup healthcheck command for the container

option.name: --health-startup-interval
tip: string           Set an interval for the startup healthcheck. Changing this setting resets the timer, depending on the state of the container. (default "30s")

option.name: --health-startup-retries
tip: uint              Set the maximum number of retries before the startup healthcheck will restart the container

option.name: --health-startup-success
tip: uint              Set the number of consecutive successes before the startup healthcheck is marked as successful and the normal healthcheck begins (0 indicates any success will start the regular healthcheck)

option.name: --health-startup-timeout
tip: string            Set the maximum amount of time that the startup healthcheck may take before it is considered failed (default "30s")

option.name: --health-timeout
tip: string                    the maximum time allowed to complete the healthcheck before an interval is considered failed and SIGKILL is sent to the healthcheck process (default "30s")
